text_en: The word of the Lord that came to the prophet Jeremiah concerning the nations.
text_cn: 上主传给耶肋米亚先知论及外邦的话。

text_en: Concerning Egypt, about the army of Pharaoh Neco, king of Egypt, which was by the river Euphrates at Carchemish and which King Nebuchadrezzar of Babylon defeated in the fourth year of King Jehoiakim son of Josiah of Judah:
text_cn: 关于埃及：对于埃及王法郎乃苛，于犹大王约史雅的儿子约雅金第四年，在幼发拉的河附近的加克米士，被巴比伦王拿步高击败的军队：

text_en: Prepare buckler and shield, and advance for battle!
text_cn: 你们应准备盾牌铠甲，冲锋上阵！

text_en: Harness the horses; mount the steeds! Take your stations with your helmets, whet your lances, put on your coats of mail!
text_cn: 骑士，你们应装备战马，快骑上，戴上盔，磨快枪，披甲出阵！

text_en: Why do I see them terrified? They have fallen back; their warriors are beaten down, and have fled in haste. They do not look back— terror is all around! says the Lord .
text_cn: 怎么？我看见他们惊惶溃退，他们的勇士遭受袭击，急速奔逃，不敢回顾，竟然恐怖四起？──上主的断语。

text_en: The swift cannot flee away, nor can the warrior escape; in the north by the river Euphrates they have stumbled and fallen.
text_cn: 敏捷的不能逃脱，英勇的不能自救，在靠近幼发拉的河的北岸，瓦解覆灭！

text_en: Who is this, rising like the Nile, like rivers whose waters surge?
text_cn: 那如尼罗，水波起伏如河流，涌上来的是谁？

text_en: Egypt rises like the Nile, like rivers whose waters surge. It said, Let me rise, let me cover the earth, let me destroy cities and their inhabitants.
text_cn: 埃及如尼罗，水波起伏如河流，涌上来说：“我涌上来淹没大地，扫灭城市和城中的居民。

text_en: Advance, O horses, and dash madly, O chariots! Let the warriors go forth: Ethiopia and Put who carry the shield, the Ludim, who draw the bow.
text_cn: 战马上前，战车急驰，战士出阵，持盾的雇士人和普特人，张弓的路丁人！

text_en: That day is the day of the Lord God of hosts, a day of retribution, to gain vindication from his foes. The sword shall devour and be sated, and drink its fill of their blood. For the Lord God of hosts holds a sacrifice in the land of the north by the river Euphrates.
text_cn: 这一天正是我主万军的上主，报复自己仇敌的复仇日，刀剑必要吞噬（shì）、饱尝、痛饮他们的鲜血；在靠近幼发拉的河北岸，我主万军的上主必要执行一场大屠杀。

text_en: Go up to Gilead, and take balm, O virgin daughter Egypt! In vain you have used many medicines; there is no healing for you.
text_cn: 埃及的处女！你尽管上基肋阿得去拾取香草，只是徒然增添药材；你已无法治疗！

text_en: The nations have heard of your shame, and the earth is full of your cry; for warrior has stumbled against warrior; both have fallen together.
text_cn: 万民闻知了你的羞辱，大地充满了你的哀哭；噫！勇士冲向勇士，双方同时倒仆。

text_en: The word that the Lord spoke to the prophet Jeremiah about the coming of King Nebuchadrezzar of Babylon to attack the land of Egypt:
text_cn: 上主论及巴比伦王拿步高前来攻击埃及地，对耶肋米亚先知说的话：

text_en: Declare in Egypt, and proclaim in Migdol; proclaim in Memphis and Tahpanhes; Say, “Take your stations and be ready, for the sword shall devour those around you. ”
text_cn: 你们在埃及宣传，在米革多耳传报，在诺夫及塔黑培乃斯传布说：你起来准备！刀剑已在你四周撕杀。

text_en: Why has Apis fled? Why did your bull not stand? —because the Lord thrust him down.
text_cn: 怎么，阿丕斯逃跑了，你的牛神也站立不住？原来上主已将它推倒。

text_en: Your multitude stumbled and fell, and one said to another, “Come, let us go back to our own people and to the land of our birth, because of the destroying sword. ”
text_cn: 你的混合部队已离心溃退，各向自己的同僚说：起来，回到我们的民族，我们的生身地去，远避吞杀的刀剑！

text_en: Give Pharaoh, king of Egypt, the name “Braggart who missed his chance. ”
text_cn: 人应给埃及王法郎起个绰号，叫“时机过后的叫嚣。”

text_en: As I live, says the King, whose name is the Lord of hosts, one is coming like Tabor among the mountains, and like Carmel by the sea.
text_cn: 我永在──那称谓万军上主的君王的断语──有一位必要前来，势如群山中的大博尔，又如海滨的加尔默耳。

text_en: Pack your bags for exile, sheltered daughter Egypt! For Memphis shall become a waste, a ruin, without inhabitant.
text_cn: 寄居在埃及的女儿！请你自备流徙的行装，因为诺夫将要变为荒野，被火焚烧，再没有人居住。

text_en: A beautiful heifer is Egypt— a gadfly from the north lights upon her.
text_cn: 埃及是一头美丽的小母牛，但是有一只牛蝇从北方向她扑来。

text_en: Even her mercenaries in her midst are like fatted calves; they too have turned and fled together, they did not stand; for the day of their calamity has come upon them, the time of their punishment.
text_cn: 她的佣兵在她内虽像肥胖的牛犊，也一同转身逃遁，不能抵抗，因为他们遭殃的日子，受罚的时期，已来到他们身上。

text_en: She makes a sound like a snake gliding away; for her enemies march in force, and come against her with axes, like those who fell trees.
text_cn: 她发声嘶嘶好像蛇行，因为敌人正在率军前进，好像伐木的樵夫，带着斧钺向她冲来：

text_en: They shall cut down her forest, says the Lord , though it is impenetrable, because they are more numerous than locusts; they are without number.
text_cn: 砍伐她的森林──上主的断语──虽然它稠密得不可侵入，因为他们多于蝗虫，不可胜数。

text_en: Daughter Egypt shall be put to shame; she shall be handed over to a people from the north.
text_cn: 埃及女儿，已被交在北方民族手里，遭受污辱。

text_en: The Lord of hosts, the God of Israel, said: See, I am bringing punishment upon Amon of Thebes, and Pharaoh, and Egypt and her gods and her kings, upon Pharaoh and those who trust in him.
text_cn: 万军的上主，以色列的天主说：“看，我必惩罚诺地的阿孟，法郎和埃及，埃及的神祇和君王，以及信赖法郎的人，

text_en: I will hand them over to those who seek their life, to King Nebuchadrezzar of Babylon and his officers. Afterward Egypt shall be inhabited as in the days of old, says the Lord .
text_cn: 将他们交在图谋他们性命的巴比伦王拿步高和他臣仆的手中；但是以后，埃及仍如昔日有人居住──上主的断语。

text_en: But as for you, have no fear, my servant Jacob, and do not be dismayed, O Israel; for I am going to save you from far away, and your offspring from the land of their captivity. Jacob shall return and have quiet and ease, and no one shall make him afraid.
text_cn: 至于你，我的仆人雅各伯，你不用害怕；以色列，你不必惊慌；因为，看，我必从远方救出你来；从充军之地，救出你的后裔；雅各伯必将归来，居享安宁，无所恐惧。

text_en: As for you, have no fear, my servant Jacob, says the Lord , for I am with you. I will make an end of all the nations among which I have banished you, but I will not make an end of you! I will chastise you in just measure, and I will by no means leave you unpunished.
text_cn: 雅各伯，我的仆人！你不用害怕──上主的断语──有我与你同在；诚然，对我使你流徙所至的各民族，我要加以毁灭；但是你，我必不毁灭，只依照正义惩罚你，不让你全然免罚。”
